SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: Good grief, you're a lost cause.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Eh? W-Why!

TEXT: You thought of ways to persuade someone, but this is your real goal?

TEXT: Hmph... Good boy. Forget about my little sisters. Got it?

TEXT: Furthermore, that isn't the objective today, is it?

TEXT: ...Indeed it isn't.

TEXT: Don't lose sight of it again.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE

TEXT: ...Don't you wish to be alone with me, just the two of us?
